children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may test a resistance at $14,888 per metric ton this week, a break above which could lead to a gain to the $15,136-$15,473 range.
The metal climbed above a rising trendline again, suggesting a continuation of the uptrend from $12,997, which is riding on a wave c that is capable of travelling to $15,473.
A break below $14,527 may be followed by a drop into the  $13,943-$14,235 range.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
